response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT r.zoneregistry, r.insurstat, r.avg_ratio, a.status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio) SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A mesh record whose geomdeltamm is 0 has no valid ratio, so it is treated as missing (NULLIF) and ignored in the ratio average. It still counts toward the site's mesh record count.
Sites with no ratio at all (every record missing) have a NULL site ratio. They are excluded from the status average and cannot be kept.
The per-site mesh record count is computed as requested, but it is not in the final output, because the final report asks for status, average kept ratio, kept-site count and average excess.
